[SWS_CM_11103] Creating a DataWriter to handle method requests on the client side
⌈
The DDS binding shall create a DDS DataWriter for the Request Topic asso-
ciated with the methods of the ServiceInterface (see [SWS_CM_11101]) upon
proxy instantiation.
To ensure the proxy communicates only with the service instance it is bound to, the
binding implementation shall use the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_11009]
(whose partition name is "ara.com://services/<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>") to
create the DataWriter.
The DataWriter shall be configured as follows:
• DataWriterQos shall be set as specified in the Manifest,
where the
DdsMethodQosProps element defines the qosProfile that shall be used.
⌋

tition name is "ara.com://services/<svcId>_<reqSvcInId>") to create the
DataWriter.

• DataWriterQos shall be set as specified in the Manifest, where the DdsRe-
quiredServiceInstance element defines the qosProfile that shall be
used.
